desc:
🚨- USE CODE "BETA" FOR A GIFT! NEW CODE AT 100 LIKES👍

⛳ - Welcome to Untitled Golf Game! Race against other players across challenging courses, sink your shots as fast as you can, earn coins, unlock awesome rewards and cosmetics, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate golfer!

🚧 - BETA: The game is still in development, so you may encounter bugs and possibly data resets. Expect regular updates with new courses, items, and cosmetics!

🏌️ - Anything goes! Use power-ups, pull off illegal plays, outplay your friends, and race to sink your ball before everyone else.

🎮 - Controls:
Desktop: M1 - Swing / Use item (hold to charge)
M2 - Swing Stance (hold to aim)
SPACE - Dive
Mouse Wheel - Fine-tune angle

👍 - Enjoying the game? Leave a Like and Favorite to support future updates!

🐛 - Found a bug? Report it through the social links below!

✨ - Inspired by Super Battle Golf.
